name: IKHCO | Bananaconda | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
Snake Cake x Dual OG

Bananaconda is a 1g Solventless Live Rosin that slithers between creamy banana sweetness and bold tropical funk. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis using only ice, water, heat, and pressure, this small-batch concentrate preserves full-spectrum terpene expression with a smooth, flavorful melt and elevated potency. A rich, fruit-forward experience with a clean solventless finish.
